Class RewardResponse

java.lang.Object
com.rewards.rewards_api.dto.RewardResponse
public class RewardResponse extends Object
Data Transfer Object that represents aggregated reward points for a customer.

This DTO is returned by the controller and serialized to JSON for API clients. It contains the points accumulated in three time windows (0-30, 31-60 and 61-90 days) and a computed total. The DTO is intentionally simple and provides read-only accessors for serialization and test assertions.
